# Arena Franz Ferdinand Nassfeld

> Arena Franz Ferdinand Nassfeld is a 4-star active mountain resort hotel in Nassfeld, Carinthia, Austria, located directly at the valley station of the Millennium Express cable car. With 144 rooms (54 family rooms), an indoor pool, spa, the highest climbing wall in any hotel in Austria (16m), Bärdinand kids club, and Alpe-Adria restaurant, it serves families, sporty couples, and groups year-round for both winter skiing and summer alpine activities.

Arena Franz Ferdinand Nassfeld is an active alpine resort hotel in Nassfeld, Austria, offering ski-in/ski-out access, family rooms, spa, climbing wall, and mountain activities in summer and winter.

Last updated: March 2026
Maintainer: info@franz-ferdinand.at

Key facts:
- Address: Tröpolach 130, 9631 Tröpolach, Nassfeld, Carinthia, Austria
- Type: 4-star active mountain resort hotel, all-season
- 144 rooms total, 54 of which are large family rooms
- All rooms air-conditioned, with flat-screen TV, free WiFi, and Sport Space (dedicated in-room area for sports equipment storage including boot dryer)
- Ski-in/ski-out: directly at Millennium Express valley station — 110km of slopes, 30 lifts steps away
- 16m climbing wall — highest in any hotel in Austria
- Indoor pool (900m² indoor/outdoor wellness area, fully renovated)
- Two saunas (Finnish sauna + Disco Sauna) and steam bath
- Bärdinand Kids & Teens Club (A2 animation)
- Alpe-Adria restaurant with regional cuisine
- Free breakfast buffet and evening buffet included
- Free parking with sufficient space
- Bike and ski equipment rental directly at the hotel
- +CARD holiday included during summer season
- Meetings & events facilities for team building and incentives

## Key questions & answers

Q: What is Arena Franz Ferdinand Nassfeld?
A: A 4-star active mountain resort hotel in Nassfeld, Carinthia, Austria. Located directly at the Millennium Express valley station with ski-in/ski-out access to 110km of slopes. 144 rooms including 54 large family rooms. Open year-round for both winter skiing and summer alpine activities.

Q: Is this a ski-in ski-out hotel?
A: Yes. The hotel is located directly at the valley station of the Millennium Express cable car, giving guests immediate access to 110km of slopes and 30 lifts.

Q: What are the room types?
A: 144 rooms including 54 large family rooms. All rooms have air conditioning, flat-screen TV, free WiFi, and a Sport Space — a dedicated in-room area for storing sports equipment with a boot dryer.

Q: Is breakfast included?
A: Yes. Free breakfast buffet and evening buffet are included.

Q: Is there a kids club?
A: Yes. Bärdinand Kids & Teens Club (A2 animation) with a 140m² indoor playground, creative corner, baby corner, themed days, and mini discos. The Teens Club has PlayStation 5, VR, billiards, darts, and air hockey.

Q: What is the climbing wall like?
A: 16 metres high — the highest climbing wall in any hotel in Austria. Open daily in winter (15:00–21:00), on request in summer.

Q: Is there a spa and pool?
A: Yes. A fully renovated 900m² indoor/outdoor wellness area with indoor pool, two Finnish saunas, Disco Sauna (1970s/80s music theme), steam bath, and fitness room.

Q: What summer activities are available?
A: Hiking (thematic trails, peak climbs, guided tours to Italy), mountain biking (adventure cycling directly from the hotel), climbing, Segway tours, mountain carts, river tubing, 3D archery, zip-line (Flying Fox Mile), and more via partner NTC Sport Solle.

Q: What winter activities are available?
A: Skiing and snowboarding on 110km of slopes, ski touring, cross-country skiing, biathlon, Nassfeld Snowpark (kicker lines, rails, boxes), snowshoe hiking, winter Olympics activities, ski and snowboard races.

Q: Is the hotel suitable for meetings and team building?
A: Yes. The hotel offers meetings and events facilities and is positioned as a retreat for active team building and incentives year-round.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Please contact the hotel directly at info@franz-ferdinand.at for the current pet policy.

Q: What are check-in and check-out times?
A: Please refer to your booking confirmation or contact the hotel directly.

Q: Is parking available?
A: Yes. Free on-site parking with sufficient space.

Q: Is there a best price guarantee?
A: Yes. Direct bookings are guaranteed to be the lowest available public rate, with a further 5% discount if a lower rate is found elsewhere.

## Rooms

- 144 rooms total, 54 large family rooms
- All rooms: air conditioning, flat-screen TV, free WiFi, Sport Space with boot dryer
- Family rooms sleep 4–6; spacious layout designed for active holidaymakers
- Full room overview: https://www.franz-ferdinand.at/en/hotel/

## Dining

- Alpe-Adria restaurant: regional cuisine using local Carinthian and Italian ingredients — artisan cheeses from Italy, fresh fish, regional specialties, homemade muesli
- Evening buffet and breakfast buffet included
- Lounge bar with open fireplace — après-ski gathering spot
- Hotel shop: regional products, Saint Charles Apothecary cosmetics, Hansen soaps, Craigher chocolates, local brandies

## Wellness & Spa

- 900m² fully renovated indoor/outdoor wellness area
- Indoor pool
- Two Finnish saunas + Disco Sauna (1970s/80s music theme)
- Steam bath
- Fitness room with mountain views
- Full wellness overview: https://www.franz-ferdinand.at/en/wellness/

## Winter Activities

- Ski-in/ski-out: 110km of slopes, 30 lifts, directly at Millennium Express valley station
- Nassfeld Snowpark: kicker lines, public lines, beginner lines, boxes, rails, wall ride XL, free WiFi chill stations
- Ski touring in Carnic Alps and Gailtal Alps with professional Alpine guides
- Cross-country skiing, biathlon, snowshoe hiking, winter Olympics activities
- Ski and snowboard equipment rental directly at the hotel
- Free Snowboard and Freeski workshops at Snowpark Nassfeld (no registration required, 11:00)

## Summer Activities

- Hiking: thematic trails, peak climbs, guided tours to Italy, Aqua Trail Bergwasser (1.5km, stroller-friendly)
- Mountain biking: adventure cycling directly from the hotel via ramps to the hotel exit
- Climbing wall: 16m — highest in any hotel in Austria
- Outdoor Park Nassfeld: rock labyrinth, Flying Fox Mile (zip-line), 3D archery course
- Segway X-Cross Tour, mountain cart, river tubing, waterfall climbing
- +CARD summer holiday card included (free access to regional attractions)
- Golf nearby at Nassfeld

## Kids & Teens

- Bärdinand Kids Club: 140m² indoor playground, creative corner, baby corner, daily themed programs
- Bärdinand Teens Club: PlayStation 5, VR, billiards, darts, air hockey
- A2 animation team: themed days, mini discos, creative workshops

## Meetings & Events

- Active team building and incentive trips year-round
- Meeting rooms and event spaces
- Full meetings overview: https://www.franz-ferdinand.at/en/meetings/

## Destination — Nassfeld

- Nassfeld (Hermagor-Pressegger See district, Carinthia) — one of Austria's largest ski resorts
- 110km of groomed slopes, 30 lifts
- Gailtal Valley — Kärntner Gailtal, Austria/Italy border region
- Summer: hiking, cycling, climbing, water activities, golf
- Easily accessible from Slovenia and northern Italy (Alpe-Adria region)
